newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF PERNILLA WIBERG.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF PERNILLA WIBERG.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Pernilla Wiberg, who won the women's World Cup slalom and finished third in the super g at Mammoth Lakes on Friday to clinch the overall and season slalom titles:
World Cup wins: 20 World Cups wins, seven this season

Other: A seven-year veteran of World Cup racing, Pernilla has now won her first season titles -- overall and slalom. She has six medals from past world championships and Olympics and excels in all disciplines. A little dynamo and one of the most popular women on the circuit, the 26-year-old skier prepared for her second race in one day by going for a jog between races.
